items.title: Ray-Ban Meta Audio AI Glasses Cost More While Ditching a Key Feature: Review
items.title_ko: Ray-Ban Meta Audio AI Glasses Cost More While Ditching a Key Feature: Review
items.summary_ko: Meta Platforms Inc.’s $349-and-up Ray-Ban Meta Audio, announced last month, are an odd proposition. On the one hand, they’re more expensive than some of the company’s entry-level models and yet they do many of the same things: play music, make calls, answer questions through Meta’s artificial intelligence assistant, or let the wearer dictate texts and audio messages.
